objective_statement: find the free input words for which the permutation-with-initial-linear-layer reproduces the target output words exactly; the remaining output words are unconstrained

program.name: Poseidon Cryptanalysis Initiative
program.version: 2026 CICO program, read 2026-11-05; the site states "THE PROGRAM IS FINISHED"
program.redistribution: parameters and objective are published on the program's page; the round constants are derived, not redistributed

verifier: CicoInstance::is_solution rebuilds the input state and runs permutation_plus_linear, so the check goes through the permutation rather than through the polynomial system — independent of the generator and of every transformation applied to it. The program's own verifier is verify_cico_solution in poseidon-tools.
notes: The official field, state width, k, constants and objective; fewer rounds. The round constants are regenerated from (prime bits, alpha, t, R_F, R_P), so they differ from the official instance's — which is part of this row's identity, not a defect. An arbitrary CICO target need not have a base-field solution.
